{{recipesummary|category=Sweet potato recipes|servings=6|time=30 minutes|difficulty=2}}
__NOTOC__
{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (120 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Maple Syrup|maple-flavored syrup]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[cookbook:butter|butter]] or [[cookbook:margarine|margarine]]
*1 can (40 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] / 1100 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[cookbook:Sweet Potato|sweet potatoes]], drained
*[[Cookbook:Pecan|Pecan]] halves (optional)

==Procedure==
#Bring syrup and butter just to [[cookbook:boil|boil]] in large [[cookbook:skillet|skillet]] on medium heat. Reduce heat to low, and [[cookbook:simmer|simmer]] about 2 minutes. 
#Add sweet potatoes. Cook on low heat 10 minutes, gently turning sweet potatoes frequently to glaze. 
#Garnish with [[cookbook:pecan|pecan]] halves, if desired.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*You also use [[cookbook:yam|yam]]s if you so desire.

==External links==
*[http://www.cdkitchen.com/recipes/recs/319/Glazed_Sweet_Potatoes48742.shtml CDKitchen.com- Glazed Sweet Potatoes]
